title: astragalus viridis var. elatus
intro: Astragalus viridis var. elatus, commonly known as a type of legume, is a plant species in the Fabaceae family. This plant is valued for its traditional uses in medicine, particularly in Asia, where it is believed to promote overall health and well-being. The health benefits of Astragalus viridis var. elatus include its immunomodulatory and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to boost the immune system and alleviate symptoms of various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-oxidative stress, and anti-bacterial activities.
